Hammer Overview
Hammer is a primary Combat Skill. Hammer focuses mainly on dealing Crushing damage, but can also deal Electricity damage and Trauma damage. There are not many abilities, but that makes it a simple and straightforward skill for learning and mastering. Hammer consumes quite a lot of Power but deals high damage. Hammer focuses on burst damage, this means it's excellent for taking down enemies quickly.
Hammer allows the player to wield wooden clubs and metal hammers. There is no big difference between these two types of weapons. All abilities can be used with a club or a hammer. The only exception is a player using the Hammer and
Druid
combat skills; they can only use wooden clubs.
In-Game Description
Mastery of the use of Hammers and clubs in combat. Power consumption is higher than average, but so is damage. Hammers excel at rapidly murdering enemies, no more and no less.

Special abilities
Most abilities are just normal damaging abilities, but some of them have special mechanics:
No power cost but Armor cost
Reckless Slam
is an attack that doesn't drain Power, but drains the player's Armor instead if they still have Armor remaining.
Damage over time
Rib Shatter
deals a high amount of damage and causes the enemy to take Trauma damage over 20 seconds.
Stun
Leaping Smash
damages and knocks the enemy down. Enemy takes 25% additional damage from all attacks while knocked down.
Slow
Seismic Impact
damages the enemy and slows them by 90%.
Recover Armor and Power
Look At My Hammer
restores a large amount of Armor and a small amount of Power. Costs no Power.
